name: Samuel McChord Crothers (essay quoting the Memoirs of Stephen Burroughs)
why: The quoted material is clearly from Stephen Burroughs's 1798 Memoirs (the Pelham preaching imposture, the Hanover beehive raid); the ironic framing commentary reads like a genteel early-1900s essayist such as Crothers, but I cannot pin the frame text to a specific essay.
